posts.title: Added Dice Roll Tracker for Board Game Night
posts.description: Roll Tracker is a single-page web application designed to log and visualize the rolls of two 6-sided dice during a game session. It has a rolling log of each number rolled as well as a bar graph displaying the number of times each number was rolled. posts.title: Bonnaroo 2026 Artist Biographies
posts.description: I created a searchable list of artist biographies for the 2026 Bonnaroo lineup. The list can also be filtered by genre. The biographies were generated with Gemini 3, and should be a good overview of each act.
